definitions.explanation: Looking back on one's actions or behavior to evaluate and learn from them, often with a sense of regret.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反省|はんせい}している。

examples.notes: {反省|はんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ = sign of remorse

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反省|はんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧した。
examples.english: We reviewed this month's (performance) at the meeting.

notes:
USAGE: {反省|はんせい} involves looking back on past actions critically. It often implies acknowledgment of mistakes and intention to improve.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{反省|はんせい}する (to reflect, to reconsider)
・{反省|はんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧ (to urge reflection)
・{反省|はんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (shows no remorse)
・⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧{反省|はんせい}する (to deeply reflect)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・⟦{反省|はんせい}{会|かい}→反省会：28191_hanseikai⟧ (review meeting, debriefing)
・⟦{反省|はんせい}{点|てん}→反省点：28214_hanseiten⟧ (points for reflection)
・⟦{反省|はんせい}{文|ぶん}→反省文：20631_hanseibun⟧ (written apology/reflection)
・⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{反省|はんせい} (self-reflection)

CULTURAL NOTE: {反省|はんせい} is highly valued in Japanese culture. Publicly acknowledging mistakes and expressing remorse ({反省|はんせい}している) is expected in apologies.
